author: Judy A Northill

steps.title: Prepare Synthetic Controls
steps.instruction: Produce synthetic controls using the binary synthetic template oligonucleotide positive control for the in-house diagnostic real-time RT-PCR method using the following sequences:

steps.title: Prepare Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Using the SuperScript™ III Platinum™ One-Step qRT-PCR Kit (Life Technologies Catalog #11732088), prepare the reaction mix for a total volume of 20µL per reaction.

substeps.instruction: Calculate total volume for the number of reactions required plus a 'dead volume' (usually 2 extra), adjusting for robotic dispensers if necessary.

steps.title: Dispense Reagents and Template
steps.instruction: Distribute the reaction mix and template into the reaction wells for use on a Rotor-Gene 6000 / Rotor-Gene Q 5-plex (100-place rotor discs) or an ABI 7500 Fast real-time machine.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 15µl of the reaction mix into each reaction well.
Add 5µl of template (extracted RNA, controls, or NTC nuclease-free water) to reach a total reaction volume of 20µl.

steps.title: Analyze Results
steps.instruction: Evaluate the real-time fluorogenic PCR results based on the following satisfactory positive result criteria:

substeps.instruction: Confirm a sigmoidal curve (horizontal start, upward curve, exponential rise, and horizontal plateau phase).
Verify fluorescence intensity is at a suitable level compared to a positive control.
Identify a defined threshold cycle (CT) value that exceeds the threshold early in the log-linear phase.
Confirm that NTCs do not produce a curve.
Classify any result not exceeding the threshold within 40 cycles as a negative result.
